structure: repos/trade-imports-plants-frontend (DEFRA/trade-imports-plants-frontend, read on main at 2f2b07f, 27 November 2026) is the high-risk plants notification frontend: Node.js, Hapi, Nunjucks, GOV.UK Frontend 6.6.0 plus MOJ frontend and accessible-autocomplete, served on port 3003. It runs the same journey platform as the animals frontend: a journey-agnostic engine, bridge, model and services under src/server/app/ (out of this source's scope), with every piece of journey content in one set beneath it, src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/. This is a re-characterisation: the folder layout and file set are the same as at the last extract, but the code inside has moved since (among the commits since, the address-book pickers page at eight and name the chosen address, EUDPA-827, and a picker search by a country's name lists the addresses in that country, EUDPA-832), so every part is re-read in full. The scope takes in that set, src/server/app/shared/ (23 files, 2,828 lines: layout.njk, kit.js, save-actions.njk, section-caption.njk, error.njk, error-summary.njk, trail.js, set-context.js, paths.js, paging.js, render-macro.js, copy-leaves.js and the shared copy.en.js/copy.cy.js pair), the fit specs (22 files, 21 colocated with their feature and one, journey-smoke.fit.spec.js, in the repo-root fit/ folder, which also holds the 1,596-line high-risk-plants-journey.js harness, set-base.js, sign-in.js and seed-fields.js, 1,965 lines in all), and the set's own decisions and rulings ledgers. Inside the set: journeys/linear/features/ holds 19 feature folders (dashboard, hub, commodity-type, commodities, origin, arrival-status, arrival-details, consignor-select, identification-numbers, consignment-contact-select, place-of-destination, party-edit, address-book-picker, check-answers, review, declaration, confirmation, delete-notification, cancel-amend, plus the cross-page fit specs and index.js beside them), each with page.js, controller.js, an optional template.njk, fields.js where it collects, a copy/copy.en.js and copy/copy.cy.js pair, a view-model/ folder where it needs one, a <name>.fit.spec.js and unit tests; journeys/linear/flow/ holds flow.js (five sections: start, about-the-consignment, arrival-and-destination, consignment-parties and a review section behind a readyForCheckYourAnswers gate), task-rows.js (seven hub rows), entry-guard.js, section-captions/ and a 362-line happy-path fixture; journeys/linear/parties/ (91 lines) holds the picked-party rules; obligations/ (816 lines) holds the obligation manifest index.js and seven section files (origin, arrival, parties, destination, commodity, contact, review); services/commodities/ (517 lines) holds the set-owned commodity vocabulary; spec/ holds the ledgers - journey-spec.json (2,814 lines), decisions.json (97 decisions, 1,654 lines), conflicts.json (40 conflicts, 423 lines), backlog-extras.json (557 lines) and panel/ (rulings.json with 8 dockets and 83 rulings in 3,008 lines, critic.json 183 lines, README.md); docs/ (13 markdown files, 3,128 lines: README.md's served-surface reference, obligation-model.md, features.md, journey-flow-and-gates.md, services.md, limits.md, testing.md, copy-status.md, lighthouse.md and four add-a-* recipes). The served surface is a notification list at /, a task-list hub at /notifications/{journeyId}, the collecting pages commodity-type, commodities and commodities/details, origin, arrival-status, arrival-details, destinations/select, consignors/select, identification-numbers and consignment/contact/select, a review section of notification-view, declaration and confirmation, the action slugs amend, cancel-amend, copy and delete, and a party-edit page reached from a picked address. Scope leaves out the generic engine, bridge, model, analysis, page-maturity and services folders under src/server/app/ (including the persistence, address-book, countries and ports clients), and everything under src/auth, src/config, src/plugins, src/client, src/shared, test/, tests/ and eslint-rules/; five files outside the scoped folders are read narrowly because the set depends on them: src/server/app/routes-high-risk-plants.js, src/server/app/routes.js, src/server/router.js and src/server/app/bridge/fulfilment-registry.js for where the set's routes mount (part 12), and src/server/common/components/submitted-search/macro.njk for the picker's search box (part 9). The parts below cut the scope by what a user sees - a group of pages at a time - with the route registration and obligation manifest, the shared kit, the fit harness, each ledger and the set docs as parts of their own. Unit tests (*.test.js) sit inside the folders the parts name and are read for the behaviour and copy they pin down; the fit specs are claimed in their own right because the scope names them.
